title: Cursed
name: Genn
description: The Cursed is an aging king in a soldier's greatcoat, white-bearded and heavy through the shoulders, who still gives orders as though he had a country to give them for. He closed his kingdom off from the world and ruined it doing so, and knows it. He carries a lycanthropic curse of his own making, and can loose it at will into a second shape, all fur and claws and appetite, which he holds under discipline rather than fear.
history: He inherited a small kingdom and closed its borders, certain it needed nothing from outside. It was besieged anyway, and to save it he opened knowledge that had been sealed for good reason: a curse that made wolves of its defenders and then of everyone else. The walls held. His son died in the fighting, his people came out of it changed, and the court had no use for the king who had done it to them. He left his wife and what remained of that court behind and came west for the Estate's pay and its plunder, both of which he intends to spend on rebuilding.
summary: A proud and remorseful king in exile, who loosed a lycanthropic curse on his own kingdom and now fights to fund its rebuilding.

appearance.hairStyle: Thick and swept back/A shaggy mane
appearance.features: Full white beard and mutton chops/Large ears, sharp teeth, and clawed hands

magic: A lycanthropic curse he can loose at will
notes: Speaks as a commander addressing a formation: says 'we' and 'our' about matters that concern only him, and issues orders where a suggestion would do
Keeps a nightly observance learned from foreigners who kept his people from losing their minds, and puts the day's fury down before it sets
Swears by the wolf rather than the Light, and speaks of the rage as a separate thing with its own will and its own low opinion of him
Sets aside a share of everything recovered as a treasury for a country that currently has no ground under it
